themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of performing research tasks independently, often involving multi-agent systems and research platforms.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and understanding code, often integrated into IDEs or available as standalone services.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles discussing the behavior, capabilities, limitations, and societal impact of AI chatbots, including their use in research and advice-giving.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Explores AI applications for analyzing complex datasets, identifying patterns, and extracting insights, often involving tools for data formulation and analytics.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being integrated into design processes, tools, and workflows, impacting the creation and user experience of digital products.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text or data into shorter, digestible summaries, useful for research and information processing.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discusses the application of AI in testing software, products, and user interfaces, including automated testing and AI-driven quality assurance.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare, evaluate, and review different AI tools and platforms for research purposes, assessing their effectiveness and features.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on employment, job roles, hiring practices, and the skills required in the modern workforce, often based on survey data.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
